name: Curedrake
look: a pendulous bundle of curled golden-amber cured leaves with leaf wings, sleepy eyes and hooked feet on top
entry: As its leaves mature, they turn a rich, golden-amber hue and curl inward like drying tobacco bundles. It hangs upside down from sturdy branches, slowly fermenting its internal sap into a potent, dizzying toxin.
how: Evolve Nicotiny at level 22 in the sun (by day, while it isn't raining). It learns Golden Leaf Storm when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon, by day, in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Evolves into Cartelord at level 38 while it holds a King's Rock or a Relic Coin (the item is used up).
